name: Nerra Daily
description: Nerra Daily is the Nerra Network's combined daily edition. Every morning, once the day's English shows have published, Mira assembles them into one continuous listen, in a fixed order: SpaceX Daily, Tesla Shorts Time, Fascinating Frontiers, Models & Agents, Planetterrian Daily and Omni View lead, then Modern Investing Techniques, the narrative shows and the beginner track, closing on The DP Pod's good news. On Mondays the weekly shows join the rundown, and midway through Mira adds a short field note of her own. Every segment is the full, unabridged episode from that show's own feed; what Nerra Daily adds is the through-line — Mira's introductions, the connections between stories, and one place to hear it all. Subscribe to Nerra Daily for everything, or pick up any individual show from its own feed at nerranetwork.com.
